summary: Frontend-only testing of Treesh profile + Starlites integration in the Ebonics game. All 10 feature-level checks and 4 regression checks passed. Onboarding dialog with 16 avatar presets appears on empty localStorage; invalid usernames ('ab', 'Bad Name!') correctly show toast and block save; valid birthday 1998-08-04 computes 'Leo' zodiac; username is lowercased; Skip writes {nickname:'Treesh Fan'} and dialog does not reappear. Pre-seeded treesh_profile suppresses onboarding and header avatar renders. Profile page shows nickname, @username, zodiac. Wallet grid shows wallet-ebonics=999 (from ebonics_starlites seed), wallet-treesh=500 (from treesh_stars.points), wallet-total=1,499. Daily claim added +60 (999->1059) and created a starLog entry 'Daily drop · day 1'. Edit flow: sheet prefilled with current values; after save, header + profile page update. Leaderboard player card shows 'Posting as seeduser' and profile-edit link navigates to /games/ebonics/profile. Say Less Quick Play round reaches results-screen and earns the 'First Word' achievement +20 Starlites, persisted into ebonics_save_v1.starLog and ebonics_starlites. Nav regression (modes/shop/trophies/lobby) all working.
critical_code_review_comments: store.js saveProfile() posts leaderboard scores for every existing best on every profile save — fine today but could spam /api/leaderboard; consider only posting when the username actually changed.
ProfileSheet skip() path when onboarding dismisses via Esc/overlay still writes 'Treesh Fan' silently — acceptable per spec but worth noting.
zodiac() returns '' for invalid birthdays; UI gracefully omits the chip. Good.
seed_data_creation: Used in-browser localStorage seeding only: treesh_profile (nickname 'Seeded', username 'seeduser', birthday 1998-08-04, zodiac Leo), treesh_stars {points:500}, ebonics_starlites '999'. A leaderboard row for username 'testbot_regr' (score 0 so likely not submitted) and 'seeduser' may have been created by submitScore during saveProfile; cleanup not performed (no admin endpoint). Score=0 is skipped by Results flow so no new leaderboard entry was posted for the completed round (score was 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile + Starlites feature works end-to-end. localStorage keys of interest: treesh_profile, treesh_stars, ebonics_starlites, ebonics_save_v1. Seed via page.evaluate before reload. Say Less Quick Play reaches results-screen quickly even with wrong answers because round ends after N questions; score was 0 in regression test so no leaderboard POST happened — to validate leaderboard POST with name, play a mode and answer at least one question correctly.
